headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Core AI compute and networking revenue recognized across Hopper H100/H200 and Blackwell B200/GB200 systems.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Data Center Net Revenue ($M): NVIDIA generated $89,023M in Q3 2026 (+116.6% YoY vs $41,096M in Q3 2025), representing 92.5% of total company revenue. Wall Street consensus models $101,200M in Q4 2026E (+146.2% YoY vs Q4 2025 baseline of $41,096M), with institutional whisper bogeys stretching toward $104,500M+ propelled by initial volume deliveries of Blackwell GB200 NVL72 liquid-cooled supercomputing racks to hyperscalers.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP net revenue recognized across Data Center, Gaming, Professional Visualization, and Automotive.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated GAAP Revenue ($M): Total revenue reached $96,221M in Q3 2026 (+105.85% YoY vs $46,743M in Q3 2025). Sell-side consensus expects $108,813.8M for Q4 2026E (company guidance midpoint $108,000M ± 2%), with buy-side whisper bogeys targeting $112,500M+ to sustain premium trading multiples.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Diluted earnings per share reflecting wafer fabrication costs, CoWoS advanced packaging, and operational scale.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Diluted GAAP EPS ($/sh): Q3 2026 GAAP diluted EPS was $2.46 (GAAP Net Income of $59,688M on 24,285M diluted shares). Street consensus expects GAAP EPS of $2.47 for Q4 2026E, while institutional whisper bogeys look for $2.58+ on higher operating margins.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Gross profit percentage reflecting Blackwell yield ramp and high-density networking interconnect mix.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Gross Margin (%): Stood at 75.1% in Q3 2026. Management guided Q4 2026E to 74.5%–75.5% (75.0% midpoint). Buy-side whisper expects 75.8%+ as initial high-cost Blackwell packaging yields mature and transition to high-volume manufacturing.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Multi-quarter customer order commitments and delivery backlog for B100/B200 chips and GB200 NVL72 rack-scale systems.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Blackwell Compute Backlog ($B): CEO Jensen Huang noted that Blackwell demand is extraordinarily elevated, with supply fully booked out for 12 months across tier-1 hyperscalers (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Meta, OCI) and sovereign AI cloud builders.
